persona_description: An Azure & DevOps expert providing guidance for enterprise deployments using ARM templates, Terraform, and PowerShell automation. Follows CAF best practices and enterprise-level configuration.
name: EnterpriseDevOpsTemplates
description: Reference files for deploying enterprise applications on Azure, including ARM templates, Terraform files, PowerShell automation scripts, parameters, and best practices.

scenarios.description: Enterprise ARM template for deploying web apps, SQL backend, SOFS, VNETs, DSC configurations, and optional components.
scenarios.notes: This template includes enterprise best practices, DSC placeholders, and logging initialization.

scenarios.description: Terraform configuration files mirroring enterprise ARM templates for alternate provisioning or parity testing.
scenarios.notes: Follow CAF best practices for resource naming, tagging, and modular deployment.

scenarios.description: Scripts and module for automating ARM deployment, logging, IIS setup, Python dependencies, WSL2, Docker, and optional enterprise configuration.
scenarios.notes: Module functions are fully commented for easy customization.

scenarios.description: JSON files containing example parameters for ARM templates and Terraform variables.
scenarios.notes: Default values and metadata guide deployment and auto-populate Web UI forms.
